name: Etapp 7: BLT Darreluoppal - STF Såmmarlappa Fjällstuga
description: BLT Darreluoppal to STF Såmmarlappa Fjällstuga. Check current trail, access and service notices before departure.
utilities: No verified swimming place or outdoor fireplace (service)
waterSources: Natural streams and jokks along Darreluoppal-Såmmarlappa: The stage crosses and follows multiple streams/jokks. STF hut water is fetched from natural sources. Treat all natural water as condition- and treatment-dependent.

facilities.name: Darreluoppal national-park-boundary helicopter pickup/drop-off
facilities.description: Provisional access metadata for Fiskflyg's Kvikkjokk-Stáloluokta route. Do not import as confirmed helipad without exact landing coordinate.

facilities.name: BLT Darreluoppal / Tarraluoppal cabins
facilities.description: BLT cabin camp at the stage start with 36 beds, one year-round open cabin/room, emergency/help phone, limited provisions subject to availability, and Fiskflyg boundary pickup/drop-off context.

facilities.name: Darreluoppal hut-host provisions
facilities.description: Basic provisions/canned food may be sold by hut hosts, but supplies can run out and kiosk purchases are cash-only. Card/prepayment details for accommodation differ by source and should be rechecked.

facilities.name: Unnamed route ford south of Darreluoppal
facilities.description: Mapped route water crossing near the first kilometer from Darreluoppal. Field reports mention ford/stream crossings in reverse direction.

facilities.name: Darreluoppal toilets
facilities.description: Mapped toilet building near Darreluoppal hut. Check exact coordinate/use before standalone import.

facilities.name: Natural streams and jokks along Darreluoppal-Såmmarlappa
facilities.description: The stage crosses and follows multiple streams/jokks. STF hut water is fetched from natural sources. Treat all natural water as condition- and treatment-dependent.

facilities.name: No verified swimming place or outdoor fireplace
facilities.description: No official or confidently mapped bathing/swimming place or outdoor fireplace was found for this section. Hut stoves are lodging utilities, not public fire places.

facilities.name: Såmmarlappa helicopter pickup/drop-off
facilities.description: Provisional access metadata for Fiskflyg's Kvikkjokk-Stáloluokta route. Do not import as confirmed helipad without exact landing coordinate.

facilities.name: STF Såmmarlappa Fjällstuga
facilities.description: STF hut at the stage end with 18 beds, small shop, emergency/help phone, safety room, stove, woodshed, self-catering facilities, and no mobile coverage.

facilities.name: Såmmarlappa safety room / emergency shelter
facilities.description: Safety room/emergency shelter function within the Såmmarlappa hut complex. Import as standalone only if shelter taxonomy supports hut safety rooms; otherwise attach to hut metadata.

facilities.name: Såmmarlappa small shop
facilities.description: Small STF hut shop/provisions at Såmmarlappa. Availability and payment details should be rechecked before relying on it.

facilities.name: Såmmarlappa STF waste handling policy
facilities.description: STF says some sorted durable recycling can be left at huts while visitors must carry out portable trash. This is policy metadata, not a mapped bin.

facilities.name: Hängbro Slihtajåhkå
facilities.description: Suspension bridge over Slihtajåhkå in Tarradalen, crossed after the route leaves Padjelanta/Badjelánnda on the way to Såmmarlappa.

facilities.name: Streamside camp pitches
facilities.description: Mapped streamside camp-pitch candidates about one third of the way from Darreluoppal. Useful but should be verified before importing generic wild tent sites.
